messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] elevated gateway error rate detected for /v1/generate — 5xx spike to ~12% across eu-west-1. Latency p95 increased to 2.1s. Alert started ~5m ago.

maria.nguyen: seeing the same in Customer Dashboard — a handful of customers report failed requests & retries. Paging oncall. @cheng.li you up? :rotating_light:

cheng.li: oncall, grabbing it. tagging sig-runtime. first pass: checking routing and recent deploys. no deploys in last 30m from CI.

maria.nguyen: no config changes either. severity: customer-facing errors on generation endpoints.

dinesh.kumar: tails on gateway logs show lots of 502/504 from upstream model proxy. but the logs are sparse — missing request_id in many entries so correlation is hard.

cheng.li: confirmed — our trace headers from edge are not consistently making it to the proxy. tracing shows gaps for ~40% of failed samples. looks like an ingress drop for `x-rw-request-id`.

maria.nguyen: that explains why we can't tie errors to model instances. customers impacted: "acme-analytics" and "beta-social" reported increased errors and timeouts. CS notified.

dinesh.kumar: quick mitigation options: 1) route traffic away from eu-west-1 to eu-central for a short window (will spike latency) 2) enable debug logging on gateway/proxy to add synthetic request ids 3) insert temporary request-id at edge via envoy header modification.

cheng.li: prefer minimal blast radius — start with (2) + (3) to get observability and correlation, then decide on routing.

maria.nguyen: agree. do we have a safe feature-flag or runtime toggle for gateway debug?

ops-bot: runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx#quick-mitigations>

dinesh.kumar: I'm going to enable `gateway.debug_log=true` on the canary shards now, then roll to rest if we get useful correlations. doing a small rollout (1 shard) and will stream logs.

cheng.li: adding temporary header injection on ingress: Envoy patch to add `x-rw-request-id` when missing. patch applied to canary ingress. snippet I used:

```yaml
- name: envoy.filters.http.lua
  typed_config:
    "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.lua.v3.Lua
    inline_code: |
      function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
        local hdr = request_handle:headers():get("x-rw-request-id")
        if not hdr or hdr == "" then
          local uuid = request_handle:streamInfo():dynamicMetadata():get("generated_id")
          if not uuid then
            uuid = string.format("gen-%d", os.time())
          end
          request_handle:headers():add("x-rw-request-id", uuid)
        end
      end
```

cheng.li: note this is temporary — will remove once we have stable tracing.

maria.nguyen: logs from canary show we now have request ids for ~95% of requests. correlation with model-proxy 502s is now possible. forwarding sample IDs to model infra. :white_check_mark:

dinesh.kumar: model-proxy team confirms a crash loop in a specific model shard (shard-7) triggered by a malformed batch under certain seq lengths. they've patched a validation and restarted the pod. crash loop suppressed on canary.

sam.ramirez: starting traffic rebalancing from eu-west-1 -> eu-central (10% shift) to reduce pressure while we validate patch. will monitor error rate and p95.

maria.nguyen: CS update prepared: "We identified a model shard crash causing elevated 5xx for a subset of generation requests in eu-west-1. We applied a temporary observability patch and restarted affected service; traffic is being shifted while we validate the fix." sending now.

cheng.li: telemetry gap note for postmortem: missing preserved request_id across edge->gateway->proxy chain for ~6 months in certain routes. mitigation was manual injection; long-term fix: enforce header passthrough at edge + validation + add unit test in gateway e2e.

dinesh.kumar: filing a quick instrumentation stopgap PR to add mandatory `x-rw-request-id` passthrough check in our integration test harness. PR: <https://git.internal/redwood/gateway/pulls/4950>

maria.nguyen: current metrics: 5xx down from 12% -> 1.8% after restart + routing. p95 latency trending back to baseline.

sam.ramirez: handing off to next oncall @sam.ramirez (myself) for night watch — I'll keep an eye for 2h, then escalate to infra leads if regressions.

maria.nguyen: thanks everyone. action items: 
- model infra to validate fix on all shards (cheng)
- gateway team to land e2e passthrough check & remove lua patch (dinesh)
- infra to review ingress config for header drop (oncall follow-up)
- CS to send customer follow-ups and credit where appropriate (maria)

ops-bot: paging: next: @sam.ramirez, incident status page: <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1719951234>

sam.ramirez: ack, will update status page and monitor. if anyone sees new 5xx occurrences tag me. :eyes:

maria.nguyen: noted for postmortem: document gap in tracing and the short-term workaround we used. will start draft.

cheng.li: leaving logs and sample IDs in incident thread for postmortem correlation. good job team. :tada:

ops-bot: incident closed to active mitigation — transitioning to monitoring/validation.

sam.ramirez: closing handoff — last check: error rate at 0.9% and falling. continuing watch for 2h, will escalate if >2% for more than 10m.
